# Tablassert
> Extract knowledge assertions from tabular data into NCATS Translator-compliant KGX NDJSON using declarative YAML, embedded redb-backed entity resolution, and staged quality control.

This file is for two audiences: (1) YAML configuration authors and (2) package contributors.
When source code and prose docs disagree, treat `src/tablassert/models.py` and `src/tablassert/cli.py` as the current authority.
If you encounter older configurations, migrate `datassert:` to `fullmap:` (the graph-config field pointing at the entity-resolution database).
Current CLI behavior queries an embedded redb database whose primary file is `fullmap/data/fullmap.redb`; its sibling RECORDS shard files (`fullmap.s*.redb`, in the same directory) are required for lookup and must stay co-located with it.

## Quickstart
- [README](README.md): high-level overview, install snippets, and one-command graph build.
- [Documentation Site Home](docs/index.md): docs landing page and navigation context.
- [Installation Guide](docs/installation.md): local/dev/tool installation paths. Optional extras: `cli` (Cyclopts and Rich command-line runtime), `rt` (runtime-compatible Polars), `aria2` (bundled aria2c downloader), `qc` (quality-control runtime), `agent` (autonomous agent), `optimize` (GEPA prompt optimization), `distill` (distillation dataset export), and `log` (loguru-backed logging).
- [CLI Reference](docs/cli.md): the eight commands (`agent`, `build-fullmap`, `build-kg`, `distill-export`, `distill-weigh`, `quick-map`, `validate`, and `validate-kgx`) plus the app-level `--version` flag.
- [Tutorial](docs/tutorial.md): first end-to-end run from CSV input to KGX NDJSON output.

## YAML Authoring
- [Table Configuration Reference](docs/configuration/table.md): the table (`Section`) schema, template/sections patterns, and field semantics.
- [Graph Configuration Reference](docs/configuration/graph.md): the Graph config fields (`name`/`version`/`tables`/`fullmap`/`rig`, plus optional `uuid_fields`/`uuid_domain`/`uuid_on_collision` and QC controls `qc_similarity_threshold`/`qc_fuzzy_ratio_threshold`/`qc_fuzzy_partial_threshold`/`qc_aliases`) and orchestration model.
- [Use Case Gallery](docs/examples.md): real-world table-configuration patterns for common data types.
- [Tutorial Table Example](docs/examples/tutorial-table.yaml): minimal table configuration.
- [Tutorial Graph Example](docs/examples/tutorial-graph.yaml): minimal graph configuration.
- [Advanced Example](docs/configuration/advanced-example.md): complex regex, filtering, annotations, and section overrides.
- [Agent Guide](docs/agent.md): autonomous article-to-graph pipeline, checkpoints, and tooling.

## CLI and Runtime
- [Fullmap Guide](docs/fullmap.md): entity-resolution database build pipeline and redb schema.
- [CLI Entry Point](src/tablassert/cli_entry.py): console-script launcher (`main()`) and the `[cli]` runtime preflight.
- [CLI Module](src/tablassert/cli.py): the eight command implementations and the build pipeline stages.

## API Reference
- [Entity Resolution](docs/api/fullmap.md): the lower-level `resolve()` and `quick_map()` API.
- [Batch Resolution](docs/api/lib.md): the `resolve_many()` convenience function.
- [Quality Control](docs/api/qc.md): the four-stage `fullmap_audit()` pipeline.
- [Utilities](docs/api/utils.md): hashing, store keys, and deterministic edge UUIDs.

## Contributor Development
- [Contributing Guide](CONTRIBUTING.md): setup, style conventions, checks, and PR expectations.
- [Development](docs/development.md): docs-site contributor setup and the local `uv run mkdocs build --strict` docs gate.
- [Project Metadata](pyproject.toml): dependencies, tooling config, and CLI entrypoint. Optional extras: `cli`, `rt`, `aria2`, `qc`, `agent`, `optimize`, `distill`, and `log`.
- [Tests](tests/): pytest coverage and fixtures.
- [MkDocs Configuration](mkdocs.yml): docs navigation and published pages.
- [GitHub Workflows](.github/workflows/): `ci.yml` runs lint, format, type, test, and rust checks; `docs.yml` builds and deploys MkDocs; `pipy.yml` checks the project version, builds sdist and wheel artifacts, and publishes to PyPI; `tag-version.yml` tags changed project versions.
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md): release history and version notes.

## Implementation Map
- [Agent Module](src/tablassert/agent.py): article fetching, config derivation, auditing, and improvement orchestration.
- [Biolink Vocabulary](src/tablassert/biolink.py): `Categories`, `Predicates`, `Qualifiers`, `KnowledgeLevels`, `AgentTypes`, `EdgeCategories`, `EffectTypes`, `ALLOWED_EDGE_FIELDS`, and `validate_kgx` derived from the installed Biolink Model.
- [Coercion Helpers](src/tablassert/coerce.py): annotation and value coercion helpers.
- [Distillation Module](src/tablassert/distill.py): ChatML distillation record serialization.
- [Distill Reward Module](src/tablassert/distill_reward.py): reward calculation, selection policies, record/outcome joins, outcome flattening, and training-row schema normalization alongside outcome assembly and config-provenance checks.
- [Enums Catalog](src/tablassert/enums.py): Tablassert-owned configuration vocabularies (`Tokens`, `Repositories`, `InformationResources`, `Contributions`, `Comparisons`, `Functions`, `Files`, `EncodingMethods`, `FillMethods`, `SourceStatuses`, `ProvisionMechanisms`, `DataFormats`, `IngestCategories`, `ContentCategories`, `ModelingCategories`).
- [Error Types](src/tablassert/errors.py): coded exceptions and validation warnings.
- [Extras Registry](src/tablassert/extras.py): the package -> extra mapping behind the missing-dependency errors and their install hints.
- [Fullmap Module](src/tablassert/fullmap.py): embedded redb synonym resolution and ranking logic.
- [Graph Target](src/tablassert/graph_target.py): graph output target preparation and locking.
- [YAML Ingestion](src/tablassert/ingests.py): `from_yaml()`, `to_sections()`, template/section merge behavior, YAML loading, and section expansion.
- [Core Pipeline](src/tablassert/lib.py): extraction transforms, statement assembly, and graph compilation.
- [Logging](src/tablassert/log.py): optional loguru logging abstraction.
- [Pydantic Models](src/tablassert/models.py): authoritative schema for `Section` and `Graph`: table, graph, and RIG configuration models.
- [Network Resilience](src/tablassert/net.py): transient-failure classification, bounded jittered backoff, and the retrying HTTP seam.
- [NLP Helpers](src/tablassert/nlp.py): text normalization levels and preprocessing helpers.
- [Progress](src/tablassert/progress.py): pipeline progress reporting and validation formatting.
- [Quality Control](src/tablassert/qc.py): exact, fuzzy, abbreviation, and SapBERT validation stages.
- [RIG Helpers](src/tablassert/rig.py): Resource Ingest Guide normalization and serialization helpers.
- [Run Cache](src/tablassert/runcache.py): content-addressed op digests, worth-caching guards, the shared-prefix planner, and the ephemeral run cache.
- [Graph Study](src/tablassert/study.py): assertions over final KGX NDJSON.
- [Utilities](src/tablassert/utils.py): hashing, storage path constants, and filesystem helpers.
- [Package Init](src/tablassert/__init__.py): public package import surface and compiled-extension bootstrap.
- [Rust Extension](src/tablassert/rs.pyi): compiled Rust fullmap, NDJSON, UUID, and hash functions.

## Optional
- [CITATION.cff](CITATION.cff): citation metadata and the reference paper.
- [Agent Example Artifacts](examples/agent/README.md): GEPA prompt-optimization and distillation example artifacts.
